interactions.scope: Known point estimates motivated this analysis. Local freeze is not prospective registration or independent confirmation. All intervals conditional on observed input cells, fixed references, candidate pools, panels and geometry. Same D4 donor in two states, not two biological replicates. Depth uses one nested chain, not donor/chain-population inference. No equivalence, non-inferiority, universal method independence or calibrated method-switching claim.

d4_depth.scope: conditional on realized100-cell reservoir, fixed controls, queries, candidate pool and reference; nested/overlapping anchors are not independent experiments; no sequencing-cost claim

paired_metric_equivalent_depth_differenc.definition: paired finite difference when both crossings are identifiable; each other draw retained as interval[-infinity,+infinity], not discarded

d4_depth.role: prespecified secondary estimation; cannot rescue primary failure
d4_depth.interpretation: ranking-input equivalent depth conditional on this 100-cell reservoir; not total experimental cost saving
d4_depth.interpolation_caveat: piecewise linear inverse may overestimate equivalent depth on a concave curve; no smoothing or extrapolation
